relation: multigraph incidence regularity: U5 regular_m G r := forall v, #|edges_at v| = r converts to GTBase.base.mregular G r and U5 cubic to GTBase.base.mcubic G (no loopless guard; a loop counts once). U6 cubic := loopless G /\ forall v, mdeg v = 3 (arc-end degree, a loop twice) equals GTBase.base.loopless_cubic G := loopless G /\ mcubic G by an unconditional iff through Cycle.foundations.connectivity.mdeg_loopless under the guard it carries. The two contracts stay distinct.
summary: Batch A, family A13 (multigraph incidence regularity and guarded cubicity). GTBase.base.mregular G r := forall v : G, #|edges_at v| = r counts incident edges (a loop once, parallel edges separately); mcubic G := mregular G 3 has no loopless guard; loopless_cubic G := loopless G /\ mcubic G adds it. Chromatic U5 regular_m and cubic convert to mregular and mcubic; U5's three-edge-colouring conclusion keeps its unguarded cubic H exactly. Cycle U6 cubic (loopless G /\ forall v, mdeg v = 3, arc-end degrees) equals loopless_cubic by an unconditional iff through mdeg_loopless under the guard it carries; base imports no Cycle module and no arc-end degree is duplicated. Upstream mgraph.iso does not apply to the unit-labelled mgraph (no elabelType structure on unit), so transport is stated along incidence-preserving vertex/edge bijections (mregular_bij).

Eleven whole declarations are frozen verbatim at 58f2862 with the two reached chains U5.is_universal_sts and U10.cubic_bridgeless: U5 three-edge-colouring and universal Steiner triple systems (outer STS witness and validity), U6 predefined 2-regular CDC, three-decomposition, odd cycles/low oddness and strong 5-CDC, U10 intersecting perfect matchings, Petersen colouring and Berge-Fulkerson, and the two explicit external reductions of implications_U6 (non-corpus). All nonempty-vertex/edge, connectivity, bridgeless, fixed-S/circuit, multiplicity-two, size five/six and oddness conditions are kept. Six proof-only adaptations in grounding_U6/U10 and implications_U6/U10 go through mdeg_loopless/subdeg_loopless with unchanged theorem types. No earlier frozen copy touches these names on this baseline or on bc52cc3.

known_stale_snapshots.cycle-theory/theories/migration/spanning: B19 per-row snapshot: family spanning-tree (B19) froze only its multigraph tree contract (spanning_tree with its two unchanged supports) in U6's three-decomposition row, so this copy still calls the live cubic, which after A13 unfolds to GTBase.base.loopless_cubic (incidence degrees under the loopless guard). Kept as B19's per-row row; the complete pre-A13, pre-B19 row is Cycle.migration.spanning_trees.U6Original.three_decomposition_statement over this family's frozen Legacy.cubic (bound there as Module A13), certified by three_decomposition_statement_original_compat through cubic_compat.
